name: Kashiwabara Emiri
source:
She is an active female student voice actress who was registered at a voice actress production run by her father, a major voice actor.

She is blessed with good looks, but her talent for acting is not as good as she would like it to be. Even so, she was able to use her father's connections to appear in a bishojo game for home use that did not have any sex scenes. She has a bad reputation on set for her selfishness.

Kenzou was also used on the set several times, but he was annoyed by her refusal to accept even lip-noise retakes. However, her father's voice actor production company went bankrupt due to a huge fraud.

Emiri is left alone after her father and mother go missing, and she becomes a voice actress under the care of Kenzou's production company.

She becomes a new victim of Kenzou, who sees voice actors as nothing more than meat slaves.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/injyokustudio3/index.html]official site[/url]]
